No search-volume tool: Bangladeshi business searches are largely in English or romanised Bangla; the Bengali query returned mostly English pages. csvRows are the research tool’s (US-indexed) results for the exact primary keyword.
decisions: Food cart vs food truck: Dhaka’s mobile food trade is mostly ফুড কার্ট (carts) rather than trucks. Recommend keeping ফুড ট্রাক as the primary keyword (matches the product and the other markets) and adding ফুড কার্ট in the landing meta description and store keywords, as drafted. Dominic to confirm.

Digits: Bangladeshi press uses Bengali digits (৫০ টাকা) and the app’s Intl formatting already renders bn-BD numbers in Bengali digits, so typed numbers in copy should be Bengali digits too; exceptions: “2026” in comparison.meta.title / comparison.h1 kept as ASCII per the SEO rule (switch to ২০২৬ if the checker allows), plus URLs, e-mails and codes.

Pay at Hatch: “পিকআপের সময় পেমেন্ট” / “পিকআপে পেমেন্ট”. Avoid “ক্যাশ অন ডেলিভারি” (COD — the default on Bangladeshi delivery apps) and avoid “নগদে” for “in cash”: নগদ is also the name of the Nagad mobile wallet. At the truck customers pay by cash, card, bKash or Nagad.
Bangladeshi, not West Bengal / Indian: no UPI, ₹, GST, PIN code; use ৳ / টাকা, bKash, Nagad, ভ্যাট, পোস্ট কোড; prefer BD vocabulary (পানি not জল, গোসল not স্নান if it ever appears).

Messaging: Bangladeshi small food businesses take many orders through Facebook pages/Messenger; WhatsApp is used but less central than in South/West Asia — consider not leading BD pages with the WhatsApp feature (unverified, Low).
Order button: no statutory wording found (Digital Commerce Operation Guidelines 2021; Consumer Rights Protection Act 2009). Market norm “অর্ডার করুন” / “অর্ডার কনফার্ম করুন”.
